Initially restrict nonnational kills to forum and foreign: even if both traced successfully, suspect pool >=3437. Do not add a third nonnational kind without evidence it is safe: three independent 25% constraints with afternoon routine leave only ~859, causing capture. National reports are safe. Only press conferences reveal narrowing; first feedback after day 3. Need identify inaccessible kinds conservatively to expand kills and reach rolling five-day thresholds of 30/40. Day 1 total 5 kills.

Need eventually expand safely for 30/40 kills per rolling five days, but avoid a third source kind until evidence supports it.
